chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem with a man getting cupping done while he is in a state of major ritual impurity (junub).

key_terms.جُنُبٌ: a state of major ritual impurity (junub)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can a person in a state of junub undergo cupping?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that major impurity (junub) does not invalidate the efficacy of cupping, distinguishing between ritual purity required for prayer and the physical state required for medical procedures. It reflects the Shia juristic view that the prohibition of eating or reciting Quran while junub is specific to acts of worship, whereas practical acts like hijamah remain permissible without prior ghusl.
